title: Gamemode Shortcuts
description: GamemodeShortcuts — Adds short gamemode commands to Minecraft. Type /gmc for Creative, /gms for Survival, and /gmsp to toggle between Spectator and Survival.
body:
GamemodeShortcuts — Adds short gamemode commands to Minecraft. 
- TYPE:
- /gmc for Creative mode
  
- /gms for Survival mode
  
- /gmsp to toggle between Spectator and Survival mode.
